resolved.subject: microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-gguf
resolved.detail: artifact intact, but llama_cpp_python 0.3.35 cannot load it: The artifact stores tensors under a type id this llama.cpp build maps to a removed quantization. BitNet's I2_S ternary format is served by the BitNet fork of llama.cpp, not by upstream llama-cpp-python.
revisit_if: a BitNet-capable backend (upstream I2_S support, or the microsoft/BitNet fork) is added to AI_SKILL_LIBRARY/v4/local_runtime/backends
the upstream publishes a re-quantized artifact under a different digest

resolved.subject: mistralai/Ministral-3-3B-Reasoning-2512-GGUF
resolved.detail: artifact intact, but llama_cpp_python 0.3.35 cannot load it: The architecture is mistral3 and the tokenizer stores ggml.scores under a gguf type this llama.cpp build rejects. The tensor data itself parsed: the loader read 53 f32, 156 q4_K and 27 q6_K tensors before refusing the vocabulary. This is a newer model format than the available build supports.
revisit_if: llama-cpp-python is upgraded to a build whose gguf vocabulary reader accepts the mistral3 tokenizer.ggml.scores type
the upstream publishes a re-converted artifact under a different digest
